notes.title: Update v1.2.5.0
notes.notes: [p]- Updated boss music with enhanced melody[/p][p]- "Challenges" renamed to "Remix Modes" and is a different color[/p][p][/p][p]The composer (Momentvm) enhanced the melody in the boss music when working on the OST mixes, so I requested for it to be included in the game since it sounds cool.[/p][p]I noticed that the "Challenges" button under the "Standard" game mode was easily overlooked, which isn't desirable since it's where the majority of ByteRogue's content is located. I am hoping that this button looks more important now.[/p]

notes.title: Full Release Details
notes.notes: [p]With ByteRogue's full release on [b]July 24th[/b] coming soon, I would like to provide info on what this entails.[/p][p][/p][p]The game will be launching on [b]Windows[/b], but it has been tested to work on [b]Steam Deck through Proton[/b] (hopefully Valve verifies this at some point). If you have played the demo, [b]your save file should carry over[/b] to the full version through Steam Cloud.[/p][p][/p][p]The full release will feature [b]9 game modes[/b], including the base Beginner and Standard modes as well as 7 challenge modes, each one remixing the rules in different ways to keep the experience fresh. The last challenge mode may provide a nice little surprise as well. ;)[/p][p][/p][p]The game will be fully priced at [b]$2.55 USD[/b], but will have a launch discount. We'll also be selling a bundle that includes our previous game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/387060/Earth_Overclocked/"]Earth Overclocked[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to releasing Chronicle Bench's first project in over 9 years! It's good to be back![/p]

notes.notes: [p]This update provides buffs to a couple of spells and adds some QoL. More importantly, this update is preparing the game for its full release on [b]July 24th[/b]![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Dash and Block can now be used point-blank[/p][list][*][p]Dash does nothing point-blank, but lets you throw the spell away[/p][/*][*][p]Block has a new secret technique when used point-blank (Try it out!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added clarity to Spells UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added tip to "How to Play" section to encourage players to figure out the game's intricacies[/p][/*][*][p]Changed color coding of game modes in main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed tip on last floor to defeat the boss[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of behind-the-scenes changes to prepare for full release[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.2.0
notes.notes: [p]- Greatly mitigated enemies erroneously skipping their turns despite having tiles to move to (turns in this game are supposed to always be forced when able)[/p][p]- Losing in a mode that you already cleared no longer shows highest floor, in its place a reminder that you need to win for gems to count for trophies[/p][p]- F11 now toggles fullscreen (independent of the ingame setting)[/p][p]- Function keys can no longer be bound to (reserved for possible future shortcuts)[/p][p]- Further clarified Refresh Mode text[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.0.0 (Beginner Mode!)
notes.notes: [p]I have noticed players struggling with the demo, so I decided to remedy this with a new mode to help ease in new players! Unfortunately, I also had to remove the Bomb Storage challenge mode from the demo to maintain its size. Sorry about that, but you'll be able to play it again in the full release! (If you played Bomb Storage already, its progress will carry over to the full version.)[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]NEW:[/b] Beginner Mode, which has reduced starting enemies, no bad crates, and an easier boss[/p][p]- Standard Mode requires a bronze trophy from Beginner Mode to unlock (stays unlocked if you already earned a trophy before this update)[/p][p]- Refresh Mode now requires 2 trophies to unlock[/p][p]- Removed Bomb Storage Mode from demo (Sorry, demo is getting too big!)[/p][p]- Locked game modes now show their names in the menu[/p][p]- Changed Refresh Mode's description to clarify the increased enemies[/p]
